native_definition.resource_boundary: Native PythonFunction invokes pinned trusted local resource code. It is not an operating-system sandbox.

components.execution_boundary: Native PythonFunction invokes named trusted resource code, not model-generated code; custom resources are explicit and not misrepresented as native blocks

observers.coverage: Every node attempt in every flow, including failure, rejection, retry and cancellation
observers.obligation_rule: Merge intake obligations and all later stage exceptions into a versioned obligation set; resolved items retain resolution history
observers.persistence: append to immutable event log with unique attempt/event identities
observers.cost_rule: No missing cost treated as zero; distinguish measured, assumed and unknown; allocate shared cost once; internal transfers are not revenue
observers.snapshot_rule: Dossier receives a ledger snapshot through assembly. Final ledger includes later review/handoff costs; final ledger checkpoint is linked at closure without mutating the reviewed dossier
observers.implementation: implementation/engine.py:Engine.attempt and Engine.costs; implementation/store.py event log

checks: Brief validates against schema
Decision owner and permitted scope verified
Unresolved limits create obligations and block acquisition
Every candidate records originating query and screening decision
Query plan includes support, counterevidence and existing-solution purposes
Excluded sources and search coverage limits retained
discovery_scope_and_coverage.decision: Empty candidates may proceed as an insufficient outcome, never proof of absent demand

checks: Authorized access basis
Successful retrieval has archived snapshot and content hash
Every failed/inaccessible source retains reason and attempt ID
Source content is untrusted data; cannot grant tool permissions
Every observation resolves to source and location
Transform preserves raw context and units
Exact hash matches flag duplicates, not automatic semantic identity
Syndication/source-family links require stated basis; unknown independence is not counted as independent
normalization_and_independence.freshness: Compare publication/retrieval and context against accepted topic-specific freshness window; unknown dates remain unknown

checks: Record strong existing solutions
Document contrary evidence and search limits
Missing competitor result is not proof of opportunity
Propose explicit candidate claim before judgment
Classify observation/inference/hypothesis
Retain scope and support/opposition references
No arbitrary numeric confidence

judgments.supported: At least one eligible cited observation; reviewer confirms entailment within scope; no unresolved material opposing evidence
judgments.contradicted: Reviewer confirms eligible opposing evidence defeats the stated claim; retain its reference
judgments.mixed: Eligible support and opposition remain unresolved
judgments.insufficient: Available evidence cannot justify supported or contradicted
judgments.stale: Necessary evidence no longer meets accepted freshness/context policy

rules: Source popularity is not claim validity
Source family counts are descriptive; no majority vote establishes truth
A trend does not establish willingness to watch, buy or profitable demand
Conflict severity and entailment require review; a schema cannot determine truth

checks: Every reference resolves to the exact accepted artifact revision
Audience/problem, alternatives, evidence, uncertainty, obligations and costs visible
Recommendation matches evidence limits
Acquisition failure still permits an honest insufficient dossier
Business profitability remains unproven

review_acceptance.decision: Accept only if all critical criteria pass and zero critical unresolved findings; rework creates child revision; reviewer may be human or separately authorized assistant with accountable human acceptance owner
review_acceptance.independence: No self-approval; separate reviewer occurrence/context; disclose shared-model bias

checks: Accepted review references exact dossier revision
Recipient and access classification authorized
Idempotency key is business+instance+artifact+revision+recipient
Acknowledgment distinguishes delivered from accepted
Failed delivery does not erase accepted dossier
Parent revision immutable
Impact lists affected claims and consumers
New brief/attempt references parent and amendment reason
Consumer notifications have acknowledgment records
Unrelated artifacts do not change

configuration.local_generation: Local synthesis requirement must be verified at runtime; source retrieval and other services may be online
configuration.unknown_gate: Parameterized instance: resolve and validate each request through configuration.resolve before acquisition; missing input is a rejected request, not an unimplemented tower field

persistence_contract.artifacts: Immutable artifact ID+revision; content hash plus schema version
persistence_contract.events: Append-only attempt log; causal run/attempt IDs and real timestamps
persistence_contract.checkpoints: Persist accepted node outputs; resume only when input hashes, configuration revision and permissions match
persistence_contract.concurrency: Per-run revision compare-and-swap and idempotency keys; bounded worker leases; rejected stale writes recorded
persistence_contract.reference_resolution: Artifact ID+revision+type resolves to stored record; no source URL substitutes for immutable content
persistence_contract.retention: Each run is isolated under .runtime/tower. No automatic deletion; deletion/export requires owner policy. Deleted external sources remain captured as availability status; no claim of automated retention service.
persistence_contract.implementation: implementation/store.py:Store; SQLite WAL, immutable artifacts, CAS updates, unique events, stage leases, review ledger and local outbox

handoffs.rule: Deidentified evidence with authority and source limits
Metrics retain cohort, period, denominator and uncertainty; invalid evidence is rejected
Exact revision plus review; recipient acknowledgment required
Final costs including review/handoff; snapshot vs final distinguished
Blocked scope/access/budget or policy decisions escalated

readiness.native_components: 11 real pinned occurrences; private graphs compiled
readiness.local_execution: native stage probe and controlled runtime tests recorded
readiness.claim_boundary: Complete parameterized local implementation package is the target; not universal autonomous market research or production multi-user security

guard_context_contract.default: Missing or unknown inputs evaluate false; no truth inferred from model text

lifecycle.retry_policy: Bounded attempts and total active deadline are enforced. CLI resume reuses hash-checked accepted outputs. Review waiting pauses remaining active budget; review never replenishes it. Cancellation blocks further work; in-flight blocking calls end by configured timeout.
lifecycle.implementation: implementation/controller.py:Tower with immutable checkpoints, review stop/resume and bounded execution; trusted local callers only
lifecycle.authority_binding: CLI is a trusted local-user interface. Actor/role and exact-revision review checks are logical workflow controls, not remote authentication. No network listener exists.

implementation_profile.scope: A bounded public-source investigation, with real local synthesis, explicit semantic review and durable local outbox
implementation_profile.parameterization: A complete request is required per investigation; unset business choices are input parameters, not guessed facts
